name: SHIPS – Sexual Health and Intimacy Psychological Services
title: Psychologists, clinical psychologists & GPs
practice: Sexual Health and Intimacy Psychological Services (SHIPS)
description: Psychological services covering sex, intimacy and mental health; kink-friendly, poly-friendly, sex work-positive, LGBTIQA+ and disability inclusive. Individual and relationship sessions in person and online.

name: Deone Drapala
title: Accredited Mental Health Social Worker (Counsellor)
description: Queer Accredited Mental Health Social Worker in private practice as a counsellor; LGBTIQA+ specialist and Transgender & Non Binary Ally. Interests include gender dysphoria and sexuality questioning; bulk-billed telehealth, face-to-face in North Fitzroy on Thursdays.
specialties: LGBTIQA+, transgender, non-binary, gender dysphoria, sexuality questioning

name: Carol-Ann Allen
title: Psychotherapist (LMFT, PACFA Clinical Member)
description: Working within the widely diverse LGBTQ community for over 25 years. I make no assumptions that your sexuality, sexual preferences or gender identity are problematic for you; addresses early experiences of bullying or abuse.
specialties: LGBTQ, sexuality, gender identity, couples and family therapy

name: Angus Ferguson
title: Gestalt Psychotherapist (PACFA)
description: Counsellor and Gestalt psychotherapist with a background in supporting people who identify as being queer; works with anxiety, depression, intimate relationship concerns and alcohol and drug use.
